sloka: ततो महेन्द्रप्रतिमः स लक्ष्मणः पदातिनं तं निशितैः शरोत्तमैः।सृजन्तमाजौ निशितान् शरोत्तमान् भृशं तदा बाणगणैर्न्यवारयत् ।। ६.९०.५४ ।।
transliteration: tato mahendrapratimaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ padātinaṁ taṁ niśitaiḥ śarottamaiḥ।sṛjantamājau niśitān śarottamān bhṛśaṁ tadā bāṇagaṇairnyavārayat ।। 6.90.54 ।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana, the peer of great Indra, with volleys of arrows firmly held back that foe who, his excellent horses slain, now fought on foot, yet kept loosing his sharp and excellent shafts as before.
